pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū anuvassaṃ santhataṃ kārāpenti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā anuvassaṃ santhataṃ kārāpessanti yācanabahulā viññattibahulā viharissanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:1.9: amhākaṃ pana sakiṃ katāni santhatāni pañca pi cha pi vassāni honti yesaṃ no dārakā ūhananti pi ummihanti pi undurehi pi khajjanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:1.10: ime pana samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā anuvassaṃ santhataṃ kārāpenti yācanabahulā viññattibahulā viharanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:1.12: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:1.13: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te . . . vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:1.14: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhū anuvassaṃ santhataṃ kārāpessanti yācanabahulā viññattibahulā viharissanti . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:1.16: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:1.17: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhū anuvassaṃ santhataṃ kārāpenti yācanabahulā viññattibahulā viharanti . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:1.21: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā anuvassaṃ santhataṃ kārāpessanti yācanabahulā viññattibahulā viharissanti . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:1.23: n' etaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:1.24: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:1.25.1: navaṃ pana bhikkhunā santhataṃ kārāpetvā chabbassāni dhāretabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:1.26: orena ce channaṃ vassānaṃ taṃ santhataṃ vissajjetvā vā avissajjetvā vā aññaṃ navaṃ santhataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:1.27: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu Kosambiyaṃ gilāno hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:2.2: ñātakā tassa bhikkhuno santike dūtaṃ pāhesuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:2.8: navaṃ pana bhikkhunā santhataṃ kārāpetvā chabbassāni dhāretabban ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:2.9: ahañ c' amhi gilāno na sakkomi santhataṃ ādāya pakkamituṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:2.10: mayhañ ca vinā santhatā na phāsu hoti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:2.13: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:2.14: anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānassa bhikkhuno santhatasammutiṃ dātuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:2.16: tena gilānena bhikkhunā saṃghaṃ upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā vuḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:2.24: ayaṃ itthannāmo bhikkhu gilāno na sakkoti santhataṃ ādāya pakkamituṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:2.26: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho itthannāmassa bhikkhuno santhatasammutiṃ dadeyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:2.32: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa bhikkhuno santhatasammutiyā dānaṃ so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:2.37: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:2.38.1: navaṃ pana bhikkhunā santhataṃ kārāpetvā chabbassāni dhāretabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:2.39: orena ce channaṃ vassānaṃ taṃ santhataṃ vissajjetvā vā avissajjetvā vā aññaṃ navaṃ santhataṃ kārāpeyya aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyan ti. ||2||
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:3.16: ṭhapetvā bhikkhusammutiṃ aññaṃ navaṃ santhataṃ karoti vā kārāpeti vā, payoge dukkaṭaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:3.18: nissajjitabbaṃ saṃghassa vā gaṇassa vā puggalassa vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:3.21: idaṃ me bhante santhataṃ ūnakachabbassāni kārāpitaṃ aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā nissaggiyaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:3.29: parehi vippakataṃ parehi pariyosāpeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:3.33: aññass' atthāya karoti vā kārāpeti vā,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np14:3.35: vitānaṃ vā bhummattharaṇaṃ vā sāṇipākāraṃ vā bhisiṃ vā bimbohanaṃ vā karoti,
